checks: Real native home; one sidebar and no old primary rail
Exact Markdown count
Opening is metadata-only with zero network/writes
Workbench opening is passive
Explicit local refresh does not read Markdown, embed, call a model or write
All canonical documents represented; aggregation counts unique files
Ready artificial semantic data is present
Settled graph has no idle drift or continued ticks
Native keyboard pans and zooms focused map
Native tag hover highlights exactly 95 metadata members
Native hover does not reheat physics
Node drag does not select/open a note; capture released
Native wheel cursor anchor and immediate reversal
Seven intermediate native zooms: label boxes do not overlap or scale
Selected note has three exact membership segments and chips; no arbitrary pair
Candidate Compare returns exact context and disposes consent owner
Native light theme class is active
Native dark theme class is active
Canonical tag colors survive selection and theme changes
Model consent is separate and truthful about the offline test destination
Actual Apply → History → separate Undo restores all Markdown SHA256 hashes
Return revokes one-use model consent
Scope change discards late completion and old review owner
Unknown metadata is distinct from known untagged notes
Stale topology and semantic state are explicit after vault event and injected index revision
Ten layer changes and tag reorder do not restart physics or recolor existing tags
Explicit AND/OR remain distinct, while color toggles do not filter
Escape first closes local help, preserving expanded mode
Text input Escape does not collapse map
Canvas Escape exits expanded mode
Ctrl-wheel is not consumed by map camera (native input)
Native drag plus injected cancellation/lostcapture clears capture and listeners
Wheel outside canvas scrolls list
Detached renderer cannot change current camera
Hidden native tab stops simulation
Explicit pause retains usable map
Wheel remains usable while physics is paused
Paused native node drag moves its exact one-member field
ru/dark/1650: no horizontal overflow
ru/dark/390: no horizontal overflow
ru/light/1650: no horizontal overflow
ru/light/390: no horizontal overflow
Wheel in ordinary pane
Native Electron 200% wheel anchor
Reduced motion completes finite placement without a visible simulation loop
Reduced-motion native node drag moves its field without ticking
Native split wheel anchor
Focus fits tall narrow canvas using world units
Same ItemView in native popout: cursor anchor
Minimized real popout stops simulation
Dispose stops renderer and review owners
No network during any scenario
